title: Multilateral Cash Netting
description: Computes N-entity corporate cash netting: gross inter-company positions to net positions to minimum settlement legs using the BIS CPMI greedy matching algorithm (Net Settlement Framework 2012). Reports wire-count savings and netting_efficiency_pct. Corporate cash netting only -- NOT estimate_ficc_margin_netting (FICC US-Treasury clearing). Netting statement suitable for anchor_batch Merkle-leaf receipts. ZERO PII: aggregate entity balances only, no account-holder identifiers.

output_example.table_source: SWIFT gpi multilateral netting guide; ISO 20022 pacs.010 Financial Institution Credit Transfer; BIS CPMI net settlement framework 2012
output_example.regulatory_basis: Multilateral netting per SWIFT gpi multilateral netting guide; BIS CPMI net settlement framework (2012, cpmi96). NOT estimate_ficc_margin_netting (FICC clearing margin netting). This node computes corporate CASH netting for TMS / in-house-bank settlement cycles. Netting statement suitable for anchor_batch Merkle-leaf receipts.
output_example.pii_note: ZERO PII: entity IDs, currency codes, and amounts only. No account holder, beneficial owner, or personal data enters this kernel.
output_example.not_legal_advice: Not legal or accounting advice. Netting arrangements must be validated under applicable netting law (e.g. ISDA master netting agreement, national netting legislation).
output_example.anchor_surface: anchor.ainumbers.co/mcp -- use anchor_batch to anchor the netting statement as a Merkle tree (one leaf per entity). Each entity receives an individual inclusion proof of the same net settlement cycle.
